source: KC: FAO-56 Rev.1 (2025) Table 6.2 "Rice (Oryza sativa) / Flooded" row (p. 170): kc_ini 1.05, kc_mid 1.20, kc_end 1.05, h 1.00, Zr 0.50. || STAGE_DAYS: ASSUMED - NOT FOUND in FAO-56 Rev.1 (2025). That edition abolished static calendar stage lengths in favour of growing degree days; no 4-stage day table exists in it. || STAGE_GDD/T_BASE/T_UPPER: ASSUMED - NOT FOUND. Table 6.11 (2025) gives field-observed cumulative GDD per stage, but the values here were not traced to a specific row. ASSUMED - NOT FOUND (Table 6.10 exists but the values here do not match it). || DEPLETION_P: NOT FOUND for rice. FAO-56 Rev.1 (2025) Table 8.2 gives rice only "Threshold = 0.80 of theta_sat", a saturation basis, not a numeric p. The 0.20 here is a project value. || PERCOLATION: ASSUMED - NOT FOUND in FAO-56. The 2025 text uses "percolation" only for deep percolation below the root zone and tabulates no paddy rate. Project/ANGRAU value.
